title: Whisky Advent Calendar – 24 Decorative Bottles
seo_description: No need to guess which whisky the recipient likes – there's no kind to get wrong.
descriptionHtml:
The wrong kind ends up sitting in the cabinet

A real bottle requires you to guess the right kind – smoky, peaty or sweet bourbon – and if you guess wrong it sits unopened. And a bottle with a label and an age limit feels wrong to send in the mail to someone you can't check ID for.

No kind to get wrong

Behind each of the calendar's 24 doors waits a decorative bottle with a printed whisky label – no contents, no age limit, just decor to hang on the tree after December. No guessing the right kind, because there's no drink to get wrong.

What you get

  • No need to guess which whisky the recipient likes – there's no kind to get wrong
  • Counts down to Christmas without loading up on alcohol or candy
  • The bottles can be saved and hung on the tree again next Christmas
  • Can be shipped and given away with no age limit, since it isn't a drink
  • A ready-made gift straight out of the box – no wrapping needed
  • 24 decorative bottles in plastic/resin, approx. 5 x 2 cm, with printed whisky labels
  • Hanging loop/string on each bottle – hang on the tree or set on a shelf
  • Calendar box 25 x 18 x 5 cm with 24 compartments and a green Christmas design
  • No assembly – ready to give straight out of the box
  • Contains no alcohol

Frequently asked questions

Does the calendar contain alcohol?
No. The 24 bottles are decorations made of plastic/resin with printed whisky labels – nothing to drink, nothing to refill.

Can the bottles be opened?
No, they're solid decorative objects with no cap or contents to get at.

Are the bottles the same in every calendar, and are they in number order behind the doors?
We haven't had it confirmed by the supplier exactly which 24 bottles are included or whether the doors are numbered – we'll update the page as soon as we know more.

Is there an age limit for buying or shipping it?
No – since the calendar contains no alcohol, no age limit applies at purchase or delivery.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
